tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Use this when you need private airport terminals matching an airport or IATA code, city, country, region, service type, maximum price, or per-person versus per-group pricing. Returns compact entries with sources, the operator booking link (ref=planeside-mcp), the Planeside page to cite, and a note t

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Use this when you have a Planeside service id and need the full entry: access rules, price, transfer, FAQ, sources, booking link, and the canonical page to cite. Prices are indicative. Read-only. Unpublished candidate ids return an error. Does not book or take payment.

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: Use this when you need every airport that has a private terminal which is open or announced, grouped by IATA code. Each terminal includes its status, sources, and booking link. Closed terminals are omitted. Prices are indicative. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_services
tools.description: Use this when you need two to five Planeside services side by side. Pass their ids. Each side includes price, access, sources, and the booking link, plus a note when currencies or per-person versus per-group bases differ so the numbers are not treated as equivalent. Prices are indicative. Read-only.

tools.name: request_arrangement
tools.description: Use this when a person wants Planeside to arrange a live terminal whose arrangeable field is true. Records the request only. This is a request, not a booking; no payment taken; we'll confirm availability and price by email. This request is for the terminal only. It must not be packaged with a flight
